Correct. Fold: phase 1 and 3 acceptance enumerate every §2.5 audit void condition (missing wire/transcript/log, unknown record type, any tool call, non-empty tool snapshot, agent fallback, exit 0 not proof), each with a RED fixture.
Correct. Fold: explicit regression acceptance for non-blind kimi/agy dispatch and codex cleanroom (existing suites named + a byte-compare of argv/env for the unchanged paths).

Correct. Fold: live-fire canary lives in a scratch dir outside any checkout; acceptance also asserts the main checkout status/config is unchanged and nothing was written outside the seat HOME + receipt dir.
Correct. Fold: phase 2 states the bind list as a design to be proven by its own probe test; §0.1 claims only what the spike recorded (PONG/NOTOOLS + seat contents).

Correct. Fold: the pre-spend probe runs with an empty HOME and no credential binds; launch-time credential/HOME injection happens only after the probe passes; test asserts the probe argv/env carries neither.
